card.name: Repeated dose schedule in dosing tables
card.fires_on: Dose-unit or frequency words inside dosing tables where the same dose pattern repeats, such as 'twice' in 'mL twice daily', 'mg' before '/m 2' or '/h', and the dots in 'b.i.d.'.

modes.label: Twice daily in tables
modes.description: The word 'twice' after a dose amount in a table listing repeated dose rows.
modes.example: 19.5 mL twice daily 14 7 mL twice daily 21 mL twice daily 15 7.5 mL<< twice>> daily 22.5 mL twice

modes.label: Inside b.i.d.
modes.description: The first dot-letter part of the abbreviation b.i.d. after a mg amount.
modes.example: mg b.i.d. 400 mg 400 mg b.i.d. 800 mg 800 mg b<<.i>>.d. 1600 mg

modes.label: Unit after repeated number
modes.description: The unit mg after a number that repeats the previous entry, before /m 2 or /h.
modes.example: Mesna injection 240 mg/m 2 240 mg/m 2 240<< mg>>/m 2 Intravenous and Oral D

card.writes: The promoted tokens are odd short code-like strings, so there is no clear effect on dosing text.
card.plain: It lights up on units and frequency words in dosing tables where the same dose numbers repeat from row to row.
